setup_subtitle: Pre-configure your server and Wi-Fi credentials into flash memory during installation.
step1_d: Use a USB-C data cable (not charge-only) to connect the reader to your computer.
step2_d: Select the device port in the browser popup. The page will identify your chip (ESP32-C3 or ESP32-S3).
step3_d: Compatible models are highlighted. If the model was not identified automatically (e.g. X4 vs X3), click yours.
step4_d: Wait for flashing to complete (30–60 seconds). Once done, the reader restarts into Book Orbit!
faq1_q: No serial port appears in the browser popup?
faq1_a: Make sure you are using a USB data cable. Try flipping the USB-C plug. If the device was asleep, press the power button to wake it up, or hold Power + Back/Reset to reboot into download mode.
faq2_q: Device has locked bootloader from factory (Xteink)?
faq2_a: Certain Xteink units ship with USB flashing locked in factory firmware. If flashing fails to start, run the community OTA Unlocker tool once to unlock USB flashing.
faq3_q: Will my books and SD card files be deleted?
faq3_a: No. Flashing only writes to the internal ESP32 flash chip. Your MicroSD card with books and settings remains untouched.
